title: Post-Sale Customer Satisfaction Audits & Fleet Utilization Reviews
description: Intermediate sales and logistics module analyzing post-sale customer satisfaction audits & fleet utilization reviews.
learning_objectives: Master professional Evaluative Adjectives & Feedback Syntax in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in post-sale customer satisfaction audits & fleet utilization reviews
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: If the defense ministry _____ the contract by June 30, Tatra will guarantee delivery before the fiscal year-end.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause requires Present Simple ('signs') for commercial offers.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use 'will' in the if-clause of commercial contracts.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional commercial offer.
explanations.wrong_D: Past 'signed' would create an unreal Second Conditional.

questions.cz_learning_point: Contractual conditions: Never write *If the ministry will sign*. Use Present Simple: 'If the ministry signs'.
